snippet.title: FORECAST | Hot and Humid conditions continue
snippet.description: It is a warm and muggy start this morning with temperatures in the 70’s and 80’s. This afternoon, highs will reach the mid-90’s with heat index values between 100 and 105 degrees. A stray shower or two is possible near the coast this morning, but hit-or-miss storms slide inland this afternoon along the sea breeze. Whatever storms do form will fizzle after sunset. Lows will stay mild overnight in the 70’s. Through the rest of the week into Saturday, we keep the summertime pattern going. Highs will stay in the low-to-mid 90’s with triple digit heat index values. Hit-or-miss storms will be possible each afternoon, before rain chances increase Sunday into next week. The tropics are quiet.
